## Class Assets

Client-scoped asynchronous resource loading on bounded engine workers. Ready models/images feed the normal renderer.

Script global: `assets`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `load(path: string, kind: string)` | `number` | Queue bytes, image, model or baked scene or PBR level import without blocking. Returns a client-owned request id; duplicate requests share a job. |
| `status(id: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Poll loading/ready/failed/cancelled status and error. This never waits for disk or decoding. |
| `cancel(id: number)` | `void` | Request cooperative cancellation of a loading asset. Late worker results cannot publish. |
| `release(id: number)` | `void` | Release a request and its CPU cache entry; cancel work if pending. Does not remove existing scene entities or GPU copies. |
| `stats(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Inspect shared worker activity, bounded queue counts, CPU cache bytes and only this client's requests. |


## Class Audio

Scoped voice pool, streaming music and deterministic CPU mixing; classic channels share this output.

Script global: `audio`.

| Property | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sampleRate` | `number` | read | Mixer output frames per second. |
| `rendering` | `boolean` | read | A prepared or running audio frame awaits owner publication; playback queries retain the previous published state and controls require completion. |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `nativeChannelInfo(channel: number)` | `any` | Shared native/media channel AudioPlaybackInfo or null when ended. Scoped to the caller; source frame units, output-clock fades/delays and source completion remain distinct from processing tails. |
| `playbackInfo(handle: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | Exact shared AudioPlaybackInfo for a live pooled voice: decoded-source position/rate/length, publication age, running transport frames, paused/loop state and distinct stop/pause fade/resume-delay counters. |
| `scheduleVoiceResume(handle: Record<string, any>, delay_ms: number, fade_ms: number)` | `void` | Freeze a source, then resume after a sample-clock delay with a fresh fade-in. Later pause/stop/resume replaces this schedule. This schedules transport, not asset readiness. |
| `scheduleVoiceResumeWithOptions(handle: Record<string, any>, delay_ms: number, fade_ms: number, options: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Resume after an output-clock delay. Options policy:freeze (default) or preserve continues the prior input/pause fade until the deadline. reset_gain:true restarts a gain fade from zero to the latest target instead of fading transport; default false preserves an independent gain ramp. Later pause/stop/resume replaces it; EOF cancels it. Readiness is independent. |
| `channelStatus(channel: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Desired SceneState epoch and derived queued/loading/playing/paused/ended/failed readiness, position and error. Stopped declarations take precedence; frame synchronization prepares/publishes playback. |
| `play(channel: number, voice: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Classic {asset,looping?,gain?,bus?} channel, preserving SceneState trace/save semantics. |
| `stop(channel: number)` | `void` | Stop a classic channel. |
| `playAt(channel: number, voice: Record<string, any>, where: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Legacy distance-gain API. Use playSfx with spatial/follow for stereo 3D and occlusion. |
| `trackVoiceReflections(handle: Record<string, any>, settings: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Automatically refresh a spatial voice's reflection paths on bounded workers using ReflectionTrackingSpec. Movement coalesces; fixed delay history is preserved and tap plans crossfade. Initial work holds the source clock, including HRTF dependency. clearVoiceReflections disables tracking. Playback options may include reflections to register before a short source runs. |
| `beginReflectionProbe(query: Record<string, any>)` | `number` | Trace bounded single-bounce specular ReflectionQuery paths on workers against this client's prepared acoustic scene. Includes material pressure gains, arrival directions and physical/excess delays. Exceeding budgets fails visibly. |
| `beginVoiceReflections(handle: Record<string, any>, options: Record<string, any>)` | `number` | Prepare captured-pose early echoes for a spatial voice on workers. Initial preparation holds its source clock; replacement keeps the old effect. Uses existing HRTF bridge latency after HRTF is ready. Pose/scene/latency changes invalidate these static snapshots; prepare again or opt into trackVoiceReflections. |
| `reflectionStatus(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Client/restore-scoped pending/ready/failed query/preparation receipt. Ready follows publication. Release using cancelReflectionJob. |
| `cancelReflectionJob(ticket: number)` | `void` | Cancel/release reflection work and release an initial clock hold. Releasing a published receipt keeps its effect. |
| `clearVoiceReflections(handle: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Cancel pending reflection work and clear this voice's early echo history, preserving independent direct/HRTF/late-reverb processing. |
| `reflectionsVoice(handle: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | Current captured paths, scene revision, pending/error state and optional automatic tracking snapshots. Static effects require re-preparation after pose changes; tracked effects coalesce updates and expose waiting/draining state. |
| `beginReverb(settings: Record<string, any>)` | `number` | Prepare a client ReverbSettings parametric late-reverb bus on bounded CPU workers. Publishes matched resources in pooled/canonical and native/media mixers. Old effects remain until success. Replacing a room cuts its old tail; this does not simulate geometry reflections. |
| `reverbStatus(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Client/restore-scoped pending/ready/failed preparation. Ready includes published revision, settings and both mixer rates. Release with cancelReverbJob. |
| `cancelReverbJob(ticket: number)` | `void` | Cancel/release a scoped reverb preparation ticket. Releasing a published ticket keeps its installed effect. |
| `clearReverb(—)` | `void` | Cancel pending room preparation and remove this client's effect and tail from both mixers. Other clients remain unchanged. |
| `reverbSettings(—)` | `any` | Published ReverbSettings for this client, or null. Sends are post source-bus fader/duck/spatial and pre-Master; the wet return uses its own bus fader and Master once. |
| `beginHrtf(asset: string, options: Record<string, any>)` | `number` | Prepare a client asset SOFA SimpleFreeFieldHRIR or HrirAsset JSON on workers, including resampling/FFT plans. HrtfOptions defaults are accepted with {}. Ready publication replaces the client profile and re-prepares enabled voices; profile replacement is not a seamless transition. |
| `hrtfStatus(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Client/restore-scoped pending/ready/failed dataset status; ready result contains revision, format, sample rate, measurements, FIR taps and bridge latency. Release with cancelHrtfJob. |
| `cancelHrtfJob(ticket: number)` | `void` | Cancel/release a dataset preparation ticket; a successfully published profile remains installed. |
| `clearHrtf(—)` | `void` | Remove this client's profile and pending preparation, cancel its filter work, and restore stereo panning on enabled voices. Acoustic direct-path filtering remains independent. |
| `hrtfStats(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Client profile metadata, voice/pending counts, and host admission reservations. Reservations are estimates, not measured process memory. |
| `hrtfVoice(handle: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | Live client voice HRTF state: enabled plus ready/pending preparation/revision/published_direction/error; publication does not claim the audible crossfade has completed. Initial failure stays muted; update failure retains the last ready filter. Disable/re-enable to retry. |
| `setVoiceHrtf(handle: Record<string, any>, enabled: boolean)` | `void` | Enable/disable binaural rendering on a spatial voice. Enabling requires a prepared profile; source/envelope clocks wait for worker preparation. Repeated enable is idempotent. Pose updates crossfade with the profile policy. |
| `beginAcousticScene(asset: string)` | `number` | Read a client-scoped AcousticSceneSpec JSON (up to 32 MiB) and build its CPU BVH on workers. Old geometry remains until successful owner publication. Options live in the JSON; obvhs requires its host feature. |
| `beginUpdateAcousticScene(updates: Record<string, any>[])` | `number` | Atomically prepare AcousticMeshUpdate instance changes on workers, retaining local mesh BVHs and rebuilding only the library instance bounds. Previous scene/probe snapshots remain immutable. Wait for any pending scene preparation; explicitly unbind entity-driven meshes before manual changes. acousticStatus publishes the new revision. |
| `bindAcousticMesh(binding: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Follow a client World entity using AcousticMeshBindingSpec: global entity matrix times explicit local_transform. Captured poses coalesce into bounded worker commits at 50 ms minimum intervals, sharing local BVHs. Missing entities disable their mesh and report a binding error; invalid poses retain prior geometry. Inspect acousticStats.instances; derived bindings clear with scene replacement/restore. |
| `unbindAcousticMesh(mesh: number)` | `void` | Detach an entity binding and cancel any pending automatic commit for this client, retaining the last published mesh pose. Remaining bindings recapture on the next frame. |
| `beginAcousticProbe(query: Record<string, any>)` | `number` | Simulate a captured source/listener/settings query on workers. Requires a prepared scene; returns a ticket for acousticStatus. Gains exclude the mixer's existing distance curve. |
| `acousticStatus(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Nonblocking client/generation-scoped pending/ready/failed status. Ready result contains scene metadata or a direct path. Release tickets with cancelAcousticJob. |
| `cancelAcousticJob(ticket: number)` | `void` | Cancel/release a retained acoustic operation; a published scene remains installed. |
| `clearAcousticScene(—)` | `void` | Remove this client's scene and pending build, and disable acoustic processing on its active voices. Explicit probes retain their captured scene. |
| `acousticStats(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Client scene/revision/backend, instance work counters/bindings/desired/submitted/published ages/errors, source queue counts and host geometry reservations. Scene reservations are conservative, not an allocator/VRAM measurement. |
| `acousticVoice(handle: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | Read pending/result/error for a client-owned live voice. Automatic queries use latest queued poses and preserve the last ready coefficients while busy. current_revision/geometry_stale report instance geometry lag; full scene generations invalidate old work. |
| `beginPrepareSource(asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `number` | Snapshot a client asset and probe its decoder on bounded workers. Options are AudioSourcePrepareSpec: measure_frames=false (scan when the header has no count), frame_limit before processing, optional transform:{kind:siglus_jitan,percent:100..400}. Nonidentity compression decodes bounded PCM16 and bakes mono WAVE on workers; it preserves sample rate rather than changing playback rate. At most 128 MiB encoded/input and 4194304 transformed input frames; shared resident/scratch bytes and handles are bounded. sourcePreparation publishes an immutable resource handle, without playback. |
| `sourcePreparation(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Client/restore-scoped pending/ready/failed preparation; ready result has resource:{client,id} and AudioResourceInfo. Release the receipt separately from its resource. |
| `cancelSourcePreparation(ticket: number)` | `void` | Cancel/release preparation without publishing an unobserved result. Already published resources remain retained until releaseSource or restore. |
| `sourceInfo(resource: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | Read a live client's immutable AudioResourceInfo. Released/foreign/obsolete handles fail. |
| `releaseSource(resource: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Invalidate future lookups. Admitted playback and existing independent decoder leases retain encoded bytes until their actual last owner drops. Handles are not save data. |
| `beginPlaySource(resource: Record<string, any>, voice: Record<string, any>)` | `number` | Prepare an independent buffered decoder on workers from an immutable resource, without reopening VFS. VoiceSpec and spatial/acoustic/HRTF/reflection options match beginPlaySfx, excluding asset. playbackStatus returns result.handle. |
| `beginPlaySfx(voice: Record<string, any>)` | `number` | Prepare SFX on bounded workers and publish a shared mixer voice; playbackStatus returns result.handle. |
| `beginPreloadSfx(asset: string)` | `number` | Decode and cache SFX on workers without starting a voice. |
| `beginPlayMusic(name: string, voice: Record<string, any>, crossfade_ms: number)` | `number` | Open and prewarm bounded streaming music on workers; old music fades only after successful publication. |
| `playbackStatus(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Client/restore-scoped pending/ready/failed audio preparation or seek; owner polling publishes ready playback. |
| `cancelPlaybackJob(ticket: number)` | `void` | Cancel/release an audio job. Pending playback cannot publish; already published voices keep playing. Pending seek restores the prior logical position asynchronously. |
| `beginSeekVoice(handle: Record<string, any>, source_frame: number)` | `number` | Exact nonblocking seek for resident or worker-buffered sources. A newer seek supersedes an older one; pending seeks freeze the voice clock. |
| `sourceStatus(handle: Record<string, any>)` | `any` | Worker stream queue, decoded frame count, seek generation and errors, or null for a resident source. |
| `clearSfxCache(—)` | `void` | Drop this client's cached clips. Playing voices retain their own PCM and residency receipts. |
| `playSfx(voice: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | {asset,bus?,mix_group?,gain?,rate?,pitch_semitones?,priority?,looping?,loop_points?:{start,end},fade_in_ms?,paused?,spatial?,follow?:Entity,raycast_occlusion?,acoustics?:AcousticSource,binaural?:boolean,reflections?:ReflectionTrackingSpec}; acoustics requires a ready scene; binaural requires a ready HRTF profile. These use background preparation; reflections automatically follow source/listener poses. Realtime hosts require a preloaded clip or playSfxAsync. Returns scoped generation handle. |
| `playRandom(name: string, container: Record<string, any>, voice: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | Seeded weighted variants [{asset,weight?}], gain:[min,max], pitch_semitones:[min,max], avoid_repeat; optional VoiceSpec. Realtime hosts require preloaded variants. |
| `playMusic(name: string, voice: Record<string, any>, crossfade_ms: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Stream music by name; optional sample-frame loop_points; crossfade_ms fades old/new together. Looping defaults true. Offline-only; realtime hosts use playMusicAsync. |
| `stopVoice(handle: Record<string, any>, fade_ms: number)` | `void` | Stop immediately or sample-accurate fade out. |
| `pauseVoice(handle: Record<string, any>, paused: boolean)` | `void` | Pause without advancing the source or fade clock. |
| `seekVoice(handle: Record<string, any>, frame: number)` | `void` | Synchronous exact seek. Worker-buffered streams require beginSeekVoice/seekVoiceAsync. |
| `setVoice(handle: Record<string, any>, options: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Update {gain?,pan?:0..1,fade_ms?,rate?,pitch_semitones?,paused?,spatial?}. Fade applies to gain/pan. Pitch/rate change resampling speed. |
| `voice(handle: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | {playing,source_playing,position_seconds?}; playing includes pending stop completion and effect tails; source_playing excludes both. Stale/stolen/ended handles are inactive. |
| `setMixGroup(name: string, settings: Record<string, any>, fade_ms: number \| null)` | `void` | Create/update a client logical gain group in pooled and native/media mixers after validating both. Partial settings: parent?:string\|null, gain?:0..4, muted?:boolean; new defaults parent=null,gain=1,muted=false. Parent must exist in both namespaces; cycles/depth>8/budgets fail atomically. Fade uses each output clock, including silence/paused sources. This is gain control, not an effect submix. |
| `mixGroup(name: string)` | `any` | Pooled AudioMixGroupInfo for the next output frame, or null. Controls multiply voice gain and ancestors before bus/master and reverb sends. Host controls persist through playback clear/restore; DSP history is not saved. |
| `nativeMixGroup(name: string)` | `any` | Native/media mixer AudioMixGroupInfo or null. Native adapters may define scoped groups independently of pooled voices. |
| `removeMixGroup(name: string)` | `void` | Remove from both namespaces after validating neither has child groups or live voice/effect instances. Unobserved playback resolves its logical group name again at publication. |
| `setVoiceMixGroup(handle: Record<string, any>, group: string \| null)` | `void` | Route a live pooled voice to an existing client group, or null to bypass groups; preserves source position and independent voice fades. |
| `setBus(bus: string, settings: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | master/music/sfx/voice/ambient/ui {gain:0..4,muted:boolean}. |
| `bus(bus: string)` | `Record<string, any>` | Read this client's bus settings. |
| `setDucking(config: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Dialogue-driven music ducking {gain,attack_ms,release_ms}. |
| `setVoiceLimit(limit: number)` | `void` | Set this client's pool limit within the host's global budget; stop voices before lowering below the active count. |
| `setSeed(seed: number)` | `void` | Reset this client's deterministic variant generator and repeat history. |
| `setListener(listener: any)` | `void` | {position,forward,up}; null restores automatic camera listener. |
| `stats(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Mixer active/stolen/rejected voices, rendered frames, per-voice underrun frames and unclipped peak. |

Commands issued: `play` → `service.play_audio`, `stop` → `service.stop_audio`.

## Class Bitmap

Client-scoped CPU RGBA bitmaps; paths feed Layers and share its surface limits. Transient pixels are not runtime snapshots.

Script global: `bitmap`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `create(slot: number, width: number, height: number, rgba: number[] \| null)` | `string` | Create/replace a slot with uniform RGBA (default transparent). Returns __surface/<slot>. |
| `load(slot: number, source: string)` | `string` | Decode a client asset or copy an existing client surface into a mutable slot. |
| `fill(slot: number, rect: Record<string, any>, rgba: number[])` | `string` | Replace pixels inside clipped {x,y,width,height}; signed positions are allowed. |
| `blit(slot: number, source: string, options: Record<string, any>)` | `string` | Copy/blend source_rect into destination:[x,y]. Explicit mode and opacity; self-copy reads the original pixels. |
| `stretch(slot: number, source: string, options: Record<string, any>)` | `string` | Nearest-neighbor source_rect to destination rectangle with original mapping preserved after clipping. Explicit pixel math. |
| `composite(slot: number, source: string, options: Record<string, any>, coverage: string \| null)` | `string` | Composite associated RGB with copy/over/under, explicit 0..256 weight and preserve/source coverage_write. Optional coverage asset supplies alpha independently of source RGB. Stored channels remain associated; self-copies use snapshots. |
| `filterRgb(slot: number, rect: Record<string, any>, filter: Record<string, any>)` | `string` | Filter RGB bytes, retaining alpha: {kind:'fade',rgb:[r,g,b],weight:0..256} or {kind:'multiply',factors:[0..256,0..256,0..256]}. Fade floors signed deltas. |
| `info(slot: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Return client-local width, height, revision, bytes and surface path. |
| `remove(slot: number)` | `boolean` | Release this client's surface slot; return whether it existed. |


## Class Canvases

Client-scoped retained drawing canvases backed by inspectable engine Layer nodes.

Script global: `canvases`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `apply(commands: Record<string, any>[])` | `void` | Atomically apply typed canvas commands: create, clear, draw, set, copy, present and hide. Draws contain ordinary Layer specs, including positioned glyph runs. |
| `get(id: number)` | `Record<string, any> \| null` | Inspect this client's canvas dimensions and logical draw nodes, or null when absent. No flattened native frame is returned. |

Commands issued: `apply` → `canvas.create`, `apply` → `canvas.clear`, `apply` → `canvas.draw`, `apply` → `canvas.set`, `apply` → `canvas.copy`, `apply` → `canvas.present`, `apply` → `canvas.hide`.

## Class Entity

| `gameplay` | `any` | read | Gameplay component (attributes, effects, tags, abilities) or null. |

| `particles` | `any` | read | Particle emitter spec or null. |
| `vfx` | `any` | read | Modular VFX system specification or null; simulation belongs to the engine runtime. |
| `reflectionProbe` | `any` | read | Box reflection capture or null. |
| `irradianceVolume` | `any` | read | Dynamic diffuse GI volume or null. |
| `light` | `any` | read | Local light {shape:{kind:'point'\|'spot'\|'rect',...}, color, intensity, units:'candela'\|'lumens', range, shadows, enabled} or null. |

| `setCollider(collider: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `void` | Collider {shape:{kind:'box'\|'sphere'\|'capsule'\|'mesh'\|'convex_hull',...}, body?:'static'\|'dynamic'\|'kinematic'\|'kinematic_position'\|'character',mass?,density?,friction?,restitution?,ccd?,sensor?,groups?,gravity_scale?,linear_damping?,angular_damping?,locked_translation?,locked_rotation?,offset?} or null. |
| `applyImpulse(impulse: Vec3, point: Vec3 \| null)` | `void` | Apply a world-space impulse (N·s), optionally at a world-space point; saves the resulting velocity immediately. |
| `applyTorqueImpulse(impulse: Vec3)` | `void` | Apply a world-space angular impulse to a dynamic body. |
| `addForce(force: Vec3)` | `void` | Accumulate a persistent world-space force (N); saved until clearForces(). |
| `addTorque(torque: Vec3)` | `void` | Accumulate persistent world-space torque (N·m). |
| `clearForces(—)` | `void` | Clear persistent force and torque. |
| `wake(—)` | `void` | Wake a physics body. |
| `sleep(—)` | `void` | Sleep a physics body when can_sleep is enabled. |
| `setKinematicTarget(position: Vec3, rotation: Vec3 \| null)` | `void` | World-space target for a kinematic_position body at the next fixed step; rotation is XYZ degrees. |
| `setVehicle(spec: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `void` | Make this character-collider entity an arcade vehicle (ADR 0043): {wheelbase, track, ride_height, suspension, max_speed, acceleration, braking, drag, steer_degrees, steer_falloff, grip, handbrake_grip, gravity, step, max_slope} (all optional); null removes it. Vehicle state is not saved yet. |
| `drive(input: Record<string, any>, dt: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Advance the vehicle by dt seconds with {throttle -1..1, steer -1..1 (positive toward +X of the heading), brake 0..1, handbrake}; moves and orients the entity. Returns {speed, lateral, grounded, wheels, blocked, yaw}. |
| `moveCharacter(desired: Vec3, dt: number, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Move a character capsule with sliding, autostep and slope limits; returns {translation, grounded}. options {step?: 0.3, maxSlope?: 45}. |
| `setMaterial(material: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `void` | Replace the engine material; null restores imported materials. Alpha modes: opaque, mask, blend, additive, premultiplied. |

| `setReflectionProbe(probe: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `void` | Box reflection capture {extent:[hx,hy,hz], intensity?, blend_distance?, revision?} at this entity, or null. Bump revision to recapture. |
| `setLight(light: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `void` | Attach/replace a local light (spot and rect emit along local -Z) or null to remove. Intensity is candela unless units:'lumens'. |
| `setParticles(emitter: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `void` | Particle emitter {rate, burst, lifetime, speed, direction, spread_degrees, gravity, drag, size, color_start, color_end, max, additive, enabled, seed} or null. |
| `setVfx(system: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `void` | Attach or replace a modular VFX system; null removes it. CPU/GPU targets, emitter modules, parameters and renderers are explicitly validated. |

| `restartVfx(—)` | `void` | Increment the VFX revision and restart its simulation from its configured seed. |
| `runBehaviorTree(tree: string \| null)` | `void` | Run a defined behaviour tree every fixed step (null stops). |

| `setStateMachine(machine: string \| null)` | `void` | Drive animation from a defined state machine (null clears). |
| `setAnimParam(name: string, value: any)` | `void` | Set a state machine parameter (number or bool). |
| `playMontage(montage: string, section: string \| null)` | `void` | Play a montage over the state machine, optionally from a section. |
| `stopMontage(—)` | `void` | Blend the current montage out. |
| `drainAnimEvents(—)` | `Record<string, any>[]` | Take notifies/state changes {kind, name}. |
| `initAttributes(attributes: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Set attributes {Name: {base, min?, max?, max_attribute?}} (keeps effects/tags). |
| `attribute(name: string)` | `number \| null` | Current value after active effects, or null. |
| `setAttribute(name: string, base: number)` | `void` | Set an attribute's base value. |
| `applyEffect(effect: string, source: Entity \| null)` | `boolean` | Apply a gameplay effect; false if blocked by tags. |

Commands issued: `destroy` → `world.despawn`, `position` → `world.set_transform`, `velocity` → `world.set_velocity`, `angularVelocity` → `world.set_angular_velocity`, `setParent` → `world.set_parent`, `visible` → `world.set_visible`, `tween` → `world.tween`, `setMaterial` → `world.set_material`, `play` → `world.set_animation`, `setCollider` → `world.set_collider`, `applyEffect` → `world.set_gameplay`, `runBehaviorTree` → `world.set_ai`, `setParticles` → `world.set_particles`, `setVfx` → `world.set_vfx`, `setLight` → `world.set_light`, `setReflectionProbe` → `world.set_reflection_probe`, `setIrradianceVolume` → `world.set_irradiance_volume`.

## Class Physics

Persistent client-isolated rigid bodies, CCD, collision queries and joints. Simulation runs in every Runtime 16 ms world step, including pure data projects. Snapshots rebuild from saved pose, velocity, forces and joint declarations; solver warm starts are not serialized.

| Property | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gravity` | `Vec3` | read/write | Client gravity in world units/s². |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `raycast(origin: Vec3, direction: Vec3, maxDistance: number, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `any` | Closest hit {entity,point,normal,distance} or null. Options {ignore?:Entity,groups?:{memberships,filter},sensors?:false,staticOnly?:false}; never queries another client. |
| `sphereCast(origin: Vec3, direction: Vec3, radius: number, maxDistance: number, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `any` | Sweep a sphere. Returns its center at impact as point, surface normal, travel distance and a scoped entity or null. |
| `castShape(shape: Record<string, any>, pose: Record<string, any>, direction: Vec3, maxDistance: number, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `any` | Sweep box/sphere/capsule/convex_hull. Pose {translation?:Vec3,rotation_degrees?:Vec3}; dimensions are world units. Hit point is the moving shape origin at impact. |
| `overlapShape(shape: Record<string, any>, pose: Record<string, any>, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Entity[]` | All scoped bodies intersecting the supplied world-space shape; sensors are opt-in. |
| `createJoint(a: Entity, b: Entity, spec: Record<string, any>)` | `PhysicsJoint` | Create fixed/spherical/revolute/prismatic joint. Local anchors/frames, axes, optional limits and motor; revolute motor/limits use radians, prismatic meters. Saved with generational body identities. |
| `events(—)` | `Record<string, any>[]` | Drain this client's contact/sensor/force/sleep events {kind,entity,other,force,forceMagnitude}. Bounded queue; counters report dropped events. |

## Class Resources

Client-scoped archive and native image formats, transform/key profiles, dependency reads and decoded image surfaces. Enable the host's arc-formats feature for migrated plugins.

Script global: `resources`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `formats(—)` | `string[]` | List installed archive decoder IDs; unavailable formats are never reported as supported. |
| `fileFormats(—)` | `string[]` | List installed encoded-file converters. They return shared resource bytes, not a private extractor process. |
| `audioFormats(—)` | `string[]` | List installed native audio converters producing standard WAVE resources for the engine decoder/mixer. |
| `detectFile(asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Record<string, any>[]` | Offline probe of native file/audio decoders with per-plugin read budgets. Options {profile?}; live hosts use beginDecode with automatic detection, and ambiguous formats require an explicit decoder. |
| `readDecoded(asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Decode a file/audio resource and return metadata plus a bounded byte page. Options {format?,profile?,offset?,limit?}, default 4096 and maximum 65536 bytes. Decoding is CPU work; live callers should schedule it as an asset task. |
| `mountDecoded(asset: string, target: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Decode once and publish a client-scoped VFS resource at target. Normal Bitmap/Assets/Audio calls can consume it. Options {format?,profile?}; retained output shares the client's decode budget and no extracted file is written. |
| `beginProbe(asset: string, kind: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `number` | Probe archive/file/image formats on bounded workers. Poll decodeStatus and readDecode; no source opening or decoder runs on the owner. |
| `beginImage(asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `number` | Decode a native image and its scoped companions on workers. Options {format?,profile?}. publishImage commits ready immutable pixels without a main-thread copy. Retained results charge the client profile and a host-wide 256 MiB staging budget; cancelDecode releases the ticket. |
| `publishImage(ticket: number, slot: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Publish a completed image into an engine surface slot. No decoding or pixel copy occurs during this owner commit. |
| `beginDecode(asset: string, kind: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `number` | Schedule file/audio conversion (kind=file) or archive indexing (kind=archive) on the bounded CPU pool. Options {format?,profile?}. Returns a scoped ticket; owner calls never join. At most 64 retained tickets per client and 256 per host. |
| `decodeStatus(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Poll pending/ready/failed resource work without blocking. A completed decoder failure remains visible until cancelled. |
| `readDecode(ticket: number, offset: number \| null, limit: number \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Read a ready file's bounded byte page (maximum 65536) or archive metadata page (maximum 1024 entries). Pending work fails visibly rather than waiting or returning fabricated data. |
| `mountDecode(ticket: number, target: string)` | `Record<string, any>` | Publish a completed worker result into this client's VFS. For files target is a full logical filename; for archives it is a mount directory. No CPU decoder runs during publication. |
| `cancelDecode(ticket: number)` | `void` | Cancel pending work or release a retained result. Late worker output is discarded. Already mounted readers retain their own decoded-resource reservation. |
| `transforms(—)` | `string[]` | List installed byte transform IDs; profiles refer to keys supplied by the Rust host. |
| `imageFormats(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | List installed native image format IDs and standard image extensions; the runtime, Bitmap, text icons and renderer use this same registry. |
| `probeImage(asset: string)` | `string[]` | Return recognized native image IDs from bounded client asset bytes. Specific wrappers outrank their generic embedded codec during automatic decode. |
| `decodeImage(slot: number, asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `string` | Decode a client image into __surface/<slot> for Bitmap/Layer/UI/3D use. Options {format?,profile?}; external bases/masks use the same scoped VFS and keys remain in the host provider. |
| `defineProfile(name: string, profile: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Define an immutable client profile {limits?,parameters?:{format:options},rules:[{format,path?,transforms:[{algorithm,key_id?,parameters?,expected_size?}]}]}. Native options name client key aliases/companions; secret bytes remain in the host KeyProvider. Up to 32 profiles; default is created lazily. |
| `probe(asset: string)` | `Record<string, any>[]` | Probe an asset using installed formats with bounded reads. Ambiguous signatures require an explicit format when opening. |
| `list(asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Inspect archive metadata. Options {format?,profile?,offset?,limit?}; default 128 and at most 1024 entries per page. |
| `mount(asset: string, mountPoint: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Mount archive entries in this client's asset VFS, then use normal bitmap, audio and model APIs. Options {format?,profile?}. Native paths are validated; keys and decoded bytes are not saved. |


## Class Save

Client-capability snapshot operations. Captures preserve ordered VM safepoints; worker jobs perform encoding, disk I/O and validation, and prepared loads commit atomically.

Script global: `save`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `save(path: string)` | `number` | Offline snapshot/write; realtime hosts use beginSave. Returns encoded byte size. |
| `load(path: string)` | `void` | Offline read/restore; realtime hosts use beginLoad then commitLoad. A failed restore leaves the runtime unchanged. |
| `exists(path: string)` | `boolean` | Offline existence query; realtime hosts use beginExists. Permission/read errors remain errors. |
| `beginSave(path: string)` | `number` | Capture logical state and native VM checkpoints at the current owner safepoint, then serialize and write on bounded CPU/I/O workers. Returns a client ticket. Native checkpoint capture itself remains ordered. |
| `beginLoad(path: string)` | `number` | Read, decode and validate a snapshot on workers. A ready result is prepared, not applied; commitLoad publishes it at an owner safepoint. |
| `beginExists(path: string)` | `number` | Query the save capability on the bounded I/O executor. Only NotFound becomes false. |
| `status(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Poll pending/ready/failed without joining workers. Ready save returns bytes; exists returns exists; load returns prepared=true. All tickets are client/generation checked. |
| `commitLoad(ticket: number)` | `void` | Atomically apply a prepared load, preserving native restore semantics. Reject pending, wrong-kind and obsolete results. Successful restore invalidates earlier-generation jobs. |
| `cancel(ticket: number)` | `void` | Cancel/release retained work. Running atomic writes may already commit; cancellation cannot undo an existing disk write. |

Commands issued: `save` → `runtime.snapshot`, `load` → `runtime.restore`.

## Class Text

CPU-shaped rich text rendered to client-owned RGBA surfaces. Fonts must be explicitly installed.

Script global: `text`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `beginDraw(name: string, markup: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `number` | Prepare markup, shaping, icon decoding and initial raster on bounded workers. Returns a client/generation ticket; the old block remains until successful publication. |
| `beginRestore(name: string, state: Record<string, any>)` | `number` | Prepare saved text and reveal state on workers, publishing only after validation. |
| `beginMeasure(font: string, size: number, text: string)` | `number` | Measure an arbitrarily sized bounded single line on a worker; status returns metrics after completion. |
| `status(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Poll and publish completed text work without joining. Ready drawing includes surface metadata; errors and obsolete generations fail visibly. |
| `cancel(ticket: number)` | `void` | Release a ticket and cancel pending preparation. Already published blocks remain owned by Text until remove. |
| `measureSimple(font: string, size: number, text: string)` | `Record<string, any>` | Measure an unwrapped single line using simple-horizontal-v1 kerning and advances. Returns advance, line_height, ascent and descent; does not create a surface. |
| `draw(name: string, markup: string, options: Record<string, any>)` | `string` | Offline rich-text preparation; live hosts use beginDraw/drawAsync. Returns a shared surface path for a layer. |
| `state(name: string)` | `Record<string, any>` | Read content/options/reveal state for explicit persistence. |
| `restore(name: string, state: Record<string, any>)` | `string` | Offline rebuild of saved markup/options/reveal; live hosts use beginRestore/restoreAsync. Pending event queues are not replayed. |
| `pause(name: string, paused: boolean)` | `void` | Pause/resume this block's reveal clock. |
| `finish(name: string)` | `void` | Reveal remaining text. In live hosts, marker/finished events are delivered only after the worker raster is published. |
| `drainEvents(name: string)` | `Record<string, any>[]` | Drain grapheme, authored marker and finished events. |
| `remove(name: string)` | `void` | Remove block and release its dynamic surface. |

## Class Vfx

Engine-owned modular visual effects. Systems are data, particles execute on bounded CPU workers or native GPU compute; JS/TS controls instances and parameters.

Script global: `vfx`.

| Method | Returns | Description |

| `compile(system: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | Validate a modular system and typed parameter bindings without opening a device. Returns its emitter/module/target summary; unsupported modules fail. |
| `play(system: Record<string, any>, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Entity` | Spawn an entity with this VFX system. Options are ordinary World.spawn fields such as name, position, rotation, scale and parent. Simulation is published asynchronously. |
| `setParameter(entity: Entity, name: string, value: any)` | `void` | Change an existing typed parameter on this client's VFX entity without restarting its particles. |
| `pause(entity: Entity, paused: boolean)` | `void` | Freeze/resume the effect's simulation clock. |
| `stop(entity: Entity)` | `void` | Stop emission while existing particles finish. |
| `restart(entity: Entity)` | `void` | Restart an effect from its seed using a new logical revision. |
| `stats(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Read this client's published CPU counts, GPU timeline pressure and pending worker status. GPU capacity is not reported as a measured live count. |
| `drainEvents(—)` | `Record<string, any>[]` | Drain this client's bounded CPU birth, death and collision event queue. GPU event records remain on device; they are not fabricated as CPU callbacks. |

## Data

Field defaults are the serde defaults (`—`: required, or absent when unset).

### AudioResourceHandle

Used by: Audio.prepareSourceAsync / beginPlaySource / HostServices.

Ephemeral client-scoped immutable audio resource. IDs are not reused during a host process; handles never enter project or native/runtime save bytes.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client` | `u32` | — | Owning client capability. |
| `id` | `u64` | — | Host-minted resource identity, distinct from a playback voice. |

### AudioSourcePrepareSpec

Used by: Audio.beginPrepareSource / prepareSourceAsync options.

Immutable source preparation; transform runs before independent playback.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `measure_frames` | `bool` | `false` | Decode/discard to measure sources with unknown frame count. |
| `frame_limit` | `Option<u64>` | `null` | Optional decoded-input frame boundary, before any transform. |
| `transform` | `Option<AudioTransformSpec>` | `null` | Optional named PCM numeric profile; ordinary playback rate is separate. |

### AudioTransformSpec

Used by: AudioSourcePrepareSpec.transform.

CPU-baked voice processing, usable without a VM or device. Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `siglus_jitan` | `percent: u16` | Native-compatible PCM16 splice compression, preserving sample rate. |

Used by: Rust HostServices transformed resource preparation.

Worker-prepared numeric transform, separate from source transport/pitch.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SiglusJitan` | `percent: u16` | Pinned mono PCM16 splice profile; 100..400 percent, 100 exact identity. |

Encoded snapshot metadata, independent of playback cursors and devices.

| `source_frames` | `Option<u64>` | — | Bounded decoded-source length when known/measured. |
| `encoded_bytes` | `u64` | — | Immutable encoded snapshot bytes retained by the resource. |

| `resource` | `Option<AudioResourceHandle>` | — | Published resource capability, present only when ready. |

| `error` | `Option<String>` | — | Retained preparation error. |

### AudioMixGroupSettings

Used by: Audio.setMixGroup / Mixer / HostServices audio requests.

A client-owned logical gain group. Parents must exist in the same mixer namespace. This is a control graph, not a second decoder/effect engine.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `parent` | `Option<String>` | — | Optional group parent; None routes directly to the voice's fixed bus. |
| `gain` | `f32` | — | Independent linear gain, 0..4. Multiplies the voice and ancestor gains. |
| `muted` | `bool` | — | Fade toward silence while retaining the authored gain value. |

### AudioMixGroupInfo

Used by: Audio.mixGroup / nativeMixGroup / HostServices.audio_mix_group.

Owner-observed group controls; frame counters use this mixer's output clock.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `settings` | `AudioMixGroupSettings` | — | Authored target settings, independent of the currently interpolated gain. |
| `gain` | `f32` | — | Own interpolated gain for the next output frame, including mute. |
| `effective_gain` | `f32` | — | Product of current own and ancestor gains for the next output frame. |
| `fade_frames` | `u64` | — | Remaining gain fade frames, independent of voice pause/starvation. |
| `output_rate` | `u32` | — | Frames per second used by this group's fade counter. |

### AudioParameters

Used by: Rust HostServices/ChannelAudio playback parameters.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gain` | `f32` | — | Mixer voice gain, default 1. |
| `decode_gain` | `f32` | — | Legacy amplitude applied by the shared decoded-source wrapper, default 1. |
| `rate` | `f32` | — | Source playback rate, default 1. |
| `pan` | `f32` | — | Stereo balance 0..1, with 0.5 centered. |
| `looping` | `bool` | — | Repeat source input, default false. |

| `clamp_range` | `bool` | — | Clamp authored source/loop positions to the prepared source boundary. |
| `paused` | `bool` | — | Publish without consuming samples until an explicit resume. |
| `replace_fade_ms` | `f32` | — | Fade the previous channel voice after successful replacement publication. |

### AudioResumeSettings

Used by: Rust AudioRequest::ResumeWithOptions / Mixer::schedule_resume_with_settings.

Scheduled input/gain transition, independent of asset preparation.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `policy` | `AudioResumePolicy` | — | Input behavior before the output-clock deadline. |
| `reset_gain` | `bool` | — | At the deadline, cancel any unfinished gain ramp and fade from zero to the latest requested gain using fade_ms, with transport envelope open. False preserves the gain ramp and applies fade_ms to transport instead. |

### AudioResumePolicy

Used by: Rust AudioResumeSettings.policy / Mixer::schedule_resume_with_policy.

How existing input transport behaves before a scheduled resume deadline.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Freeze` | — | Freeze immediately, canceling any pending pause/stop fade. |
| `Preserve` | — | Keep running or paused, including any current pause/stop fade, until the deadline. Source EOF or completed stop cancels the scheduled action. |

### AudioPlaybackInfo

| `fade_out_frames` | `u64` | — | Remaining stop deadline or pause-fade frames; gain fades are excluded. A stop deadline is independent of a later pause envelope. |
| `resume_delay_frames` | `u64` | — | Remaining scheduled-resume delay in mixer frames. |

### LzssMode

Used by: LzssParams.mode.

`bytewise`: 8-flag control byte (LSB first, 1 = literal), 12-bit position and 4-bit length+3 in two bytes over a 4 KiB ring. `bitwise`: MSB-first bit stream, flag bit 1 = literal, configurable position/length widths. Truncated input stops decoding and the remainder stays zero, which is the behavior legacy decoders rely on for archives with padded size fields.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `bytewise` | — | — |
| `bitwise` | — | — |

Used by: TransformSpec parameters for lzss.

|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `LzssMode` | `"bytewise"` | Byte-control or MSB-first bitstream layout. |
| `initial` | `usize` | `4078` | Initial ring write position, wrapped to dictionary size. |
| `position_bits` | `u32` | `12` | Dictionary position width; bytewise requires 12. |
| `size_bits` | `u32` | `4` | Match length width; bytewise requires 4. |
| `min_match` | `usize` | `3` | Minimum match length; bytewise requires 3. |
| `invert_length` | `bool` | `false` | Bytewise only: the 4-bit length field is stored inverted (GLib). |

### PixelMath

Used by: Bitmap.blit and Bitmap.stretch mode.

| Variant | Fields | Description |

| `copy` | — | Copy/opacity-lerp all four channels; /255 with nearest rounding. |

| `mask255` | — | Straight mask blend: truncate opacity*source_alpha/255, rounded RGB, alpha = dst_alpha + floor((255-dst_alpha)*effective_alpha/255). |
| `premultiplied_mask256` | — | Premultiplied RGB + byte mask: src + floor((256-mask)*dst/256), saturating; mask zero skips, destination alpha is retained. Only opacity=255 is supported; native fade parameters need a separate operation. |

### Fog

Used by: `Environment.fog`.

Exponential height fog (the UE "ExponentialHeightFog" model): density decays with height above `base_height`; the line integral along each view ray gives the opacity, with directional inscattering toward the sun.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | `[f32; 3]` | `[0.45,0.5,0.6]` | Linear inscattered color. |
| `density` | `f32` | `0.02` | Extinction per world unit at `base_height`. |
| `height_falloff` | `f32` | `0.2` | Exponential decay per world unit of height (0 = uniform fog). |
| `base_height` | `f32` | `0.0` | World height where `density` applies. |
| `start_distance` | `f32` | `0.0` | Distance from the camera before fog starts. |
| `max_opacity` | `f32` | `1.0` | Opacity cap (keeps distant geometry and sky partly visible). |
| `sun_scattering` | `f32` | `0.0` | Extra inscattering toward the sun (color × sun color × strength). |
| `sun_exponent` | `f32` | `8.0` | Sharpness of the inscattering lobe toward the sun (1..256). |

### AutoExposure

Used by: `Environment.auto_exposure`.

Eye adaptation: exposure maps the metered average luminance to middle gray (0.18), clamped to a luminance range and adapted over time.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min_log2` | `f32` | `-8.0` | Darkest/brightest average luminance (log2) the camera adapts to. |
| `max_log2` | `f32` | `8.0` | Brightest average luminance (log2) the camera adapts to. |
| `speed_up` | `f32` | `3.0` | Adaptation rates (1/s) toward brighter and darker scenes. |
| `speed_down` | `f32` | `1.0` | Adaptation rate (1/s) toward darker scenes. |
| `compensation` | `f32` | `0.0` | Exposure compensation in stops, added to `Environment.exposure`. |

### ScreenSpaceReflections

Used by: `Environment.reflections` (ADR 0023).

Screen-space reflections (ADR 0023): rays marched against the depth prepass, radiance reprojected from the previous HDR frame, blended over the prefiltered environment specular by hit confidence and roughness.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `intensity` | `f32` | `1.0` | Strength of the screen-space contribution (0..4). |
| `max_distance` | `f32` | `30.0` | World-space ray length (m). |
| `thickness` | `f32` | `0.3` | Depth tolerance (m) for counting a ray as behind a surface. |
| `max_roughness` | `f32` | `0.6` | Roughness at which reflections have fully faded to the environment. |
| `steps` | `u32` | `48` | Linear march steps (refined by a binary search). |
| `ray_traced` | `bool` | `false` | Trace GGX glossy rays against the scene when the renderer runs the hardware ray-tracing path (ADR 0058); screen space otherwise. The technique actually used is reported in the RT statistics. |
| `ray_samples` | `u32` | `16` | GGX rays per pixel on the hardware path (1..64); exact mirrors use one. |

### RayTracedGi

Used by: `Environment.ray_traced_gi` (ADR 0060).

| `max_distance` | `f32` | `30.0` | Ray length in world meters; misses use environment irradiance. |
| `intensity` | `f32` | `1.0` | Multiplier of the computed diffuse irradiance (0..16). |

### GeometryLod

Used by: `Environment.geometry_lod` (ADR 0026).

| `gpu` | `bool` | `true` | Select and frustum-cull clusters on the GPU (compute + indirect draws); false keeps the CPU reference path. |

### VirtualShadows

Used by: `Environment.virtual_shadows` (ADR 0027).

Virtual shadow maps for the sun (ADR 0027): camera-centred clipmap of 8192² virtual levels; level 0 has `texel_size` meters per shadow texel. Replaces the cascades when set.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `texel_size` | `f32` | `0.02` | Meters per shadow texel at level 0. |
| `levels` | `u32` | `10` | Clipmap levels (1..16); level l has texel `texel_size·2^l`. |

### LightShape

Used by: `LightSpec.shape`.

Local light shape. Point and spot lights are punctual; a rect light is a one-sided area emitter facing the entity's -Z (spot axis convention). Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `point` | — | Omnidirectional punctual light (candela). |
| `spot` | `inner_degrees: f32, outer_degrees: f32` | Cone along local -Z with inner/outer half angles (degrees). |
| `rect` | `size: [f32; 2]` | One-sided area light of `size` [w, h], facing local -Z. |
| `directional` | — | Parallel light along local -Z confined to the range sphere (a local "light volume"); intensity is illuminance (lux), not candela. |
| `ambient` | — | Uniform diffuse irradiance inside the range sphere (an ambient volume); intensity is illuminance (lux). |

### LightUnits

Used by: `LightSpec.units`.

Photometric unit of [`LightSpec::intensity`].

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `candela` | — | Luminous intensity (lm/sr), the renderer's native unit. |
| `lumens` | — | Total luminous flux. Point and spot lights use lm / 4π (as UE does, so narrowing a cone does not brighten it); rect lights use lm / π. |

### Falloff

Used by: `LightSpec.falloff`.

Distance attenuation inside [`LightSpec::range`]. Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inverse_square` | — | Physical 1/d² with a smooth window ending at the range. |
| `exponent` | `exponent: f32` | `(1 − d²/r²)^exponent` with no 1/d² term (UE's non-inverse-squared lights, and artist-tuned lights of older engines). Intensity is then the illuminance at the light's position. |

| `intensity` | `f32` | `1.0` | Multiplier of the captured radiance (0..16). |
| `blend_distance` | `f32` | `0.5` | Distance inside the box faces over which the probe fades in. |
| `revision` | `u32` | `0` | Bump to request a recapture of an unchanged probe (e.g. after moving lights). |
| `source` | `Option<String>` | — | Authored equirect Radiance `.hdr` radiance instead of an engine capture (e.g. converted legacy cubemaps; ADR 0025). |
| `parallax` | `bool` | `true` | Box-projected (true) or infinitely distant (false) reflections. |

### IrradianceVolumeSpec

Used by: `EntitySpec.irradiance_volume`, `Entity.setIrradianceVolume` (ADR 0028).

Dynamic diffuse global illumination volume (ADR 0028): a grid of irradiance probes centred on the entity, refreshed a few per frame by rendering the lit scene around each probe. Each refresh sees the previous result, so bounces accumulate over updates.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `extent` | `[f32; 3]` | `[1.0,1.0,1.0]` | Half size of the volume (world axes, meters). |
| `counts` | `[u32; 3]` | `[8,4,8]` | Probes per axis (≥ 2 each, ≤ 4096 in total). |
| `intensity` | `f32` | `1.0` | Multiplier of the indirect diffuse light (0..16). |
| `probes_per_frame` | `u32` | `8` | Probes refreshed per frame, round-robin (1..256); each costs six capture renders. |
| `idle_probes_per_frame` | `u32` | `0` | Probes refreshed per frame once every probe has been refreshed three times and no light, static object, material override, sun or environment changed (0 = stop refreshing until something changes). |
| `visibility` | `bool` | `true` | Chebyshev visibility from per-probe distance moments against light leaking through walls (false: interpolate without occlusion). |
| `revision` | `u32` | `0` | Bump to restart accumulation. |
| `ray_traced` | `bool` | `false` | On the hardware ray-tracing path, update probes with ray queries against the scene instead of six raster face captures (ADR 0059). Ray-traced updates light hits by the sun, emission and the volume itself, including shared point/spot/rect and volume lights (ADR 0060). |

| `direction` | `[f32; 3]` | `[0.0,1.0,0.0]` | Emission axis in entity space. |
| `spread_degrees` | `f32` | `0.0` | Cone half angle around `direction`. |
| `gravity` | `[f32; 3]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Constant acceleration (world units/s²). |
| `drag` | `f32` | `0.0` | Linear velocity damping (1/s). |
| `size` | `[f32; 2]` | `[0.1,0.02]` | Start/end size (world units). |
| `color_start` | `[f32; 4]` | `[4.0,2.0,0.6,1.0]` | Linear HDR color + alpha at birth and death. |
| `color_end` | `[f32; 4]` | `[1.0,0.2,0.05,0.0]` | Linear HDR color + alpha at death. |
| `max` | `u32` | `512` | Maximum live particles. |
| `additive` | `bool` | `true` | Additive blending (false: alpha blending). |
| `enabled` | `bool` | `true` | Emit new particles (live ones finish). |
| `seed` | `u32` | `0` | Random seed, for reproducible emission. |

### LayerFilter

Used by: `Layers.setFilter` (ADR 0021).

Per-layer 2D filter stack with the stage order and parameter meaning of the Siglus/tona3 sprite effect (ADR 0021). Color math runs on 8-bit gamma-encoded values like the original: distortion sampling → tint/alpha → tone curve → invert → mono → bright → dark → color rate → add → mask → gray-as-alpha → alpha test.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mono` | `f32` | `0.0` | Mix toward grayscale (0..1). |
| `invert` | `f32` | `0.0` | Mix toward the inverted color (0..1). |
| `bright` | `f32` | `0.0` | Mix toward white (0..1). |
| `dark` | `f32` | `0.0` | Mix toward black (0..1). |
| `color_rate` | `f32` | `0.0` | Mix toward `color` (0..1). |
| `color` | `[f32; 3]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Target color of `color_rate` (0..1 per channel). |
| `add` | `[f32; 3]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Signed per-channel addition (-1..1). |
| `tone_curve` | `Option<ToneCurve>` | `null` | Tone-curve LUT lookup, or `null`. |
| `mask` | `Option<LayerMask>` | `null` | Grayscale mask image multiplied into alpha, or `null`. |
| `alpha_test` | `bool` | `false` | Discard pixels whose alpha is below 1/255. |
| `distortion` | `Option<Distortion>` | `null` | Source-sampling distortion, or `null`. |

### Distortion

Used by: `LayerFilter.distortion`.

Source-sampling effects (Siglus wipe modes 1–6), in texture UV space. Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mosaic` | `cut: f32, aspect: f32` | Cells of `cut` UV width; height = cut × `aspect`. |
| `raster` | `vertical: bool, fractions: f32, waves: f32, power: f32, progress: f32` | Sinusoidal row (`vertical: false`) or column offset driven by `progress`. |
| `radial_blur` | `center: [f32; 2], power: f32, coeff: f32` | Radial blur toward `center` (UV), 10 weighted taps. |
| `threshold_fade` | `fade: f32, threshold: f32, invert: bool` | Multiply alpha by `fade` where luminance ≤ `threshold` (or ≥ when `invert`). |

### TransitionSpec

Used by: `Layers.transition` (ADR 0022).

Full-screen transition from the engine's previously presented scene to the current one. Named engine effects have explicit contracts; the `Siglus` variant separately preserves its native WIPE table (ADR 0022).

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `effect` | `TransitionEffect` | — | Transition effect. |
| `duration_ms` | `u64` | — | Duration in milliseconds. |
| `easing` | `Easing` | — | Progress curve (Siglus speed modes 0-3). |

### TransitionEffect

Used by: `TransitionSpec.effect`.

Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `crossfade` | — | Plain cross-dissolve. |
| `mask` | `asset: String, fade: u8` | Grayscale mask image: bright pixels reveal first; `fade` 0..=8 is the Siglus soft-edge step (0 = hard edge). |
| `slide` | `direction: u8` | direction 0 down, 1 up, 2 right, 3 left (Siglus type 200, both scenes move). |
| `mosaic` | `size: u32` | Mosaic out of the old scene and into the new one (type 230). |
| `ordered_dither` | `cell: [u32; 2], diagonal: bool, steps: u32` | Ordered Bayer-4 fade in logical canvas pixels. This is a shared engine effect with an independent code, not an alias for a Siglus wipe type. |
| `siglus` | `code: i32, options: Vec<i32>, mask: Option<String>` | A raw Siglus wipe type with its option list. Pattern types (5..=199) without `mask` use the original generated masks. |

A damped pendulum: weighted input parameters swing it, its angle drives an output parameter (hair, accessories, breathing sway).

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `String` | — | — |
| `inputs` | `Vec<PendulumInput>` | — | — |
| `output` | `String` | — | Output parameter, set to `angle / max_angle` mapped onto its range. |
| `max_angle` | `f32` | — | Angle (degrees) reached for a fully saturated input. |
| `stiffness` | `f32` | — | Spring stiffness (1/s²) and damping (1/s). |
| `damping` | `f32` | — | — |

## Adapter configs

`clients[].config` of each original-VM adapter.

### `avg32`

| Field | Rust type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `profile` | `String` | Explicit native profile: non-novel, no custom frame/effects, plain text. |
| `scenes` | `BTreeMap<i32, String>` | Native scene number to capability-relative TPC32 file. |
| `start_scene` | `i32` | Scene number used by the original Scenario at boot. |
| `version` | `i32` | Original opcode revision; choose explicitly for the title being adapted. |
| `encoding` | `String` | Native string codec accepted by the original NLS parser (default sjis). |
| `font` | `String` | Installed engine font alias; no font file or native font is bundled. |
| `message_rect` | `[i32; 4]` | Absolute position and cell-layout width/height in logical pixels. |
| `font_size` | `u16` | Native nominal glyph size in logical pixels (1..256). |
| `cell_step` | `[i32; 2]` | Native horizontal half-cell and line pitch in pixels; never inferred from font metrics. |
| `message_interval_ms` | `i32` | Original interpreter print interval in milliseconds (0 displays immediately). |
| `resources` | `BTreeMap<String, String>` | Native resource names to engine image/audio paths. No filesystem bypass. |
| `sound_effects` | `BTreeMap<i32, String>` | Explicit native SE table; a referenced missing entry fails visibly. |
| `voices` | `BTreeMap<i32, String>` | Native voice IDs mapped to shared supported audio containers. |
| `message_icon` | `Option<String>` | Explicit engine image used for native message-wait icons. |

### `krkr`

| Field | Rust type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `root` | `String` | Game directory inside the client's asset root ("" is the root). |
| `startup` | `String` | First script executed, KiriKiri's `startup.tjs`. |
| `font_alias` | `String` | Project font alias used for every KiriKiri font face. |
| `canvas` | `[u32; 2]` | Logical canvas size; must equal the project canvas. |
| `plugin_shells` | `Vec<String>` | Explicit registration-only native modules, with no callable exports. Loading a shell does not establish implementation of that plugin. |

### `reallive`

| Field | Rust type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `root` | `String` | — |
| `font_alias` | `String` | — |
| `encoding` | `Option<String>` | — |
| `start_scene` | `Option<i32>` | — |

### `siglus`

| Field | Rust type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `scene` | `String` | Asset path of the compiled scene: a `Scene.pck` or a single `.scn`. |
| `format` | `String` | "pck" (scene pack, default) or "scn" (one scene stream). |
| `scene_name` | `Option<String>` | Entry scene; default "entry" for scn, the pack's scene 0 for pck. |
| `string_codec` | `String` | Scene string encryption: "xor" (default) or "plain". |
| `gameexe` | `Option<String>` | Asset path of the decoded UTF-8 Gameexe ini, if any. |
| `resources` | `BTreeMap<String, String>` | Native resource path → asset path aliases (at most 4096). |
| `message_window` | `Option<crate::MessageWindow>` | Explicit mapping for the bounded plain-text MWND profile. Native Gameexe windows/markup are not guessed from a project canvas. |

## JavaScript/TypeScript asynchronous helpers

These bindings return CancellablePromise values over the same bounded service jobs. Each Promise captures its initiating client and restore generation; continuations run on the script owner during lifecycle polling. `cancel()` releases pending work; atomic writes already committed cannot be undone. Image/asset/decode helpers return retained tickets that callers release after use. Save.loadAsync commits its prepared result at an owner safepoint.

| Helper | Parameters | Returns | Native start |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Audio.prepareSourceAsync` | `asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginPrepareSource` |
| `Audio.playSourceAsync` | `resource: Record<string, any>, voice: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginPlaySource` |
| `Audio.playSfxAsync` | `voice: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginPlaySfx` |
| `Audio.preloadSfxAsync` | `asset: string` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginPreloadSfx` |
| `Audio.playMusicAsync` | `name: string, voice: Record<string, any>, crossfade_ms: number` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginPlayMusic` |
| `Audio.seekVoiceAsync` | `handle: Record<string, any>, source_frame: number` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginSeekVoice` |
| `Audio.traceReflectionsAsync` | `query: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginReflectionProbe` |
| `Audio.prepareVoiceReflectionsAsync` | `handle: Record<string, any>, options: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginVoiceReflections` |
| `Audio.prepareReverbAsync` | `settings: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginReverb` |
| `Audio.prepareHrtfAsync` | `asset: string, options: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginHrtf` |
| `Audio.prepareAcousticsAsync` | `asset: string` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginAcousticScene` |
| `Audio.updateAcousticsAsync` | `updates: Record<string, any>[]` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginUpdateAcousticScene` |
| `Audio.traceAcousticsAsync` | `query: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginAcousticProbe` |
| `Assets.loadAsync` | `path: string, kind: string` | `CancellablePromise<number>` | `load` |
| `Resources.decodeAsync` | `asset: string, kind: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null` | `CancellablePromise<number>` | `beginDecode` |
| `Resources.imageAsync` | `asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null` | `CancellablePromise<number>` | `beginImage` |
| `Resources.probeAsync` | `asset: string, kind: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginProbe` |
| `Text.drawAsync` | `name: string, markup: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null` | `CancellablePromise<string>` | `beginDraw` |
| `Text.restoreAsync` | `name: string, state: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<string>` | `beginRestore` |
| `Text.measureAsync` | `font: string, size: number, text: string` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginMeasure` |
| `Save.saveAsync` | `path: string` | `CancellablePromise<number>` | `beginSave` |
| `Save.loadAsync` | `path: string` | `CancellablePromise<void>` | `beginLoad` |
| `Save.existsAsync` | `path: string` | `CancellablePromise<boolean>` | `beginExists` |
